item.title: Now that’s a stove! Stone Lion Inn Bed and Breakfast in Oklahoma. $675,000
item.description: How that is one heck of a stove! Love the huge porch! The Stone Lion Inn Bed and Breakfast was built in 1900. It is located on six acres in Guthrie, Oklahoma. The house features a large wrap around front porch, upper porch, a porte cochere, grand staircase, wood floors, pocket doors, large mantels, spacious kitchen, amazing stove, bay windows, wainscoting and a claw foot tub. There is a large sunroom and a large attic. Six bedrooms, seven bathrooms and 5,347 square feet. $675,000 Contact Carroll

item.title: Schoolhouse transformation! Circa 1890. Over an acre in Pennsylvania. $349,500
item.description: How about this schoolhouse transformation! They did a nice job. I like the yellow in the kitchen! The school was built in 1890. It is located on 1.45 acres in Reinholds, Pennsylvania. The house features a front porch, a screened in back porch, wood floors, old chalk boards, wainscoting, pressed tin ceiling, built-in bookshelves and a breakfast nook. There are a few outbuildings on the property. One bedroom, one bathroom and 1,543 square feet. $349,500 Contact Lisa Tiger with Century 21 Gold: 610

item.title: Love the long driveway! Circa 1852. Over two acres in South Carolina. $345,000
item.description: I love the long driveway! Such a pretty setting! The house was built in 1852. It is located on 2.53 acres in Lynchburg, South Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, a porte cochere, some wood floors, baseboards, crown moulding, knotty pine, brick fireplace, built-in bookshelves, bead board and chair rails. Not a fan of the flooring in the kitchen. Five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 3,176 square feet. $345,000 Contact Debbie Lee with The Litchfield Company: 803-938-3083 From the Zillow

item.title: Double porch love! Great staircase! C. 1898 in Texas. $325,000
item.description: Double porch love! Beautiful staircase and pocket doors! Really pretty features inside! The Webb-Schneider House was built in 1898. It is located in La Grange, Texas. The house features double front porches, pretty staircase, wood floors, wide baseboards, pocket doors, transom windows, crystal chandelier, nice kitchen sink and a claw foot tub. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,230 square feet. $325,000 Contact Marcie Naughton with CB&A Realtors: 713-418-0331 From the Zillow listing: A Historic

item.title: Thomas Day woodwork inside! C. 1850 in North Carolina. $319,000
item.description: There is Thomas Day woodwork inside! This is in his hometown and just a few doors down from his former workshop and now state historical site. There is a nice walking trail across the road from this house. The home was built in 1850. It is located on .29 acre in Milton, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, hand-carved mantels by Thomas Day, wood floors, baseboards, crown moulding and Thomas Day door casements. item.title: Fixer Upper Alert! Great porch! C. 1920 in Virginia. $52,000
item.description: Fixer upper alert! That’s a nice porch! This house was originally built for the upper management of the local coal mine. The house was built in 1920. It is located on .57 acre in Appalachia, Virginia. The house features a large wrap around porch, wood floors, baseboards and paneled wainscoting. Would be nice to get in there, clean it out, open curtains and see what is there. Hard to tell with these pictures. I would offer $30-35k and see what happens. item.title: This is picture perfect! That barn is huge! Has a guesthouse! 211 acres in Vermont. $1,750,000
item.description: This is picture perfect! I love the guest cabin and how about that goat! This property and house is known as Timberland Farm. it is a legacy farm. The main house was built in 1812. It is located on 211 acres in Londonberry, Vermont. The house features a covered front porch, wide plank wood floors, hand hewn beams, pretty fireplace, built-ins, baseboards and knotty pine. There is a beautiful barn on the property and a guest house. Seven bedrooms, five bathrooms and 4,649 square feet. $1,750,000 F

item.title: So cool! A cabin, a store, a bar, cafe and music venue! Six creek side acres in West Virginia. $399,000
item.description: This would be so fun to own! There is an old store, a bar, cafe, music venue and a cabin. The store was built in 1928. It is located on 6.25 acres in Amsted, West Virginia. The property is situated creek side in the New River Gorge Valley area. There are lots of possibilities with this property! There is even a smaller cabin that could be used as an office. Four bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,500 square feet. $399,000 Contact Anna Marie Coffman with Fathom Realty: 757-715-2335 From the Zillow l

item.title: Pretty house! Great price! C. 1848. Almost an acre in Alabama. $235,000
item.description: This is a pretty house! It’s a great price! The home was built in 1848. It is located on .86 acre in Marion, Alabama. The house features a covered porch, balcony, a porte cochere, pretty staircase, wood floors, french doors, crown moulding, wide baseboards, beautiful sunroom and transom window. There is a detached garage on the property. Five bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,518 square feet. $235,000 Contact Kay Beckett with Bill Mackey Real Estate From the Zillow listing: C.1848, grand home with

item.title: Wow! Virginia’s most expensive old house listing! Bollingbrook, C. 1809. $11,200,000
item.description: Amazing! Welcome to Virginia’s most expensive old house listing! I started researching this property and then researched the owner (now deceased) and what a remarkable woman she was! Known as Bollingbrook. The manor house was built in 1809. It is located on 355 acres in Upperville, Virginia. The last owner was Rose Marie Bogley. She was a very competent side saddle horseback rider and she was an animal rescuer.
